exposure: emigration from the Indian subcontinent to Europe
cohort: Pregnant women from the Indian subcontinent who either emigrated to Europe or stayed in their original countries.
finding: Emigration by itself did not directly influence birth weight; maternal BMI and gestational age at delivery were the true determinants of birth weight.
gest_age: recorded, but specific values not given
birth_weight: low overall, but similar between groups (30th percentile)
